end.objective: Deliver Grass Leaf Ointment to Settler Layla

start.text: Settler Layla says Mayor Romanas is headed to the Temporary Settler Camp. Go and talk to Mayor Romanas.

end.text: Mayor Romanas believes in your talent and will make sure you're admitted into Orsha immediately. Officer Lutas is looking for you; go find him at the Orsha Migration Office.

60075.name: 오르샤(2)
task: Defeat the Poata attacking Orsha's Migration Office (0 / 1)

start.text: Officer Lutas is processing the settlers' entrance into Orsha but the task feels endless. Talk to Officer Lutas again.

progress.text: A Poata suddenly appeared at the entrance to Orsha and it's threatening the settlers! Defeat the Poata and make the entrance to Orsha safe again.{nl}{nl}A Poata suddenly appeared at the entrance to Orsha and it's threatening the settlers! Defeat the Poata and make the entrance to Orsha safe again.
progress.objective: Defeat Poata

end.text: You have defeated the Poata. Talk to Officer Lutas again.

start.text: You have defeated the Poata. Talk to Officer Lutas again.

progress.text: Your entrance formalities have been processed. You can visit Orsha now.
progress.objective: 오르샤 방문

end.text: The Lord of Orsha is looking for someone with skills. First, to find the bishop of Orsha, Urbonas, talk to Inesa Hamondale, the Lord of Orsha, at the Central Plaza.
end.objective: Talk to Inesa Hamondale, the Lord of Orsha

start.text: Settler Izna seems to be deeply worried about something. Talk to Settler Izna.

progress.text: Settler Izna believes some village residents have gotten lost on their way to Orsha. Go to Adata Highway and make a bonfire so they can spot the smoke and find their way.
progress.objective: Make a bonfire on Adata Highway

end.text: You successfully made a bonfire. Go and tell Settler Izna.

start.text: The bonfire may be set, but Settler Izna is still worried about something. Talk to Settler Izna again.

progress.text: Settler Izna thinks the bonfire may be hard to spot by the residents. Go to Adata Highway and set fire to the firewood there.
progress.objective: Set fire to the firewood on Adata Highway

end.text: You successfully defeated the Woodspirit. Go back to Settler Izna.

start.text: Settler Ivanayus seems to be struggling with something. Go and talk to Settler Ivanayus.

progress.text: Settler Ivanayus is in desperate need of supplies and willing to settle for used ones. Go to the Lumberjack Cabin and collect useful objects.
progress.objective: Collect Useful Objects

end.text: You have collected enough useful objects. Bring them to Settler Ivanayus.
end.objective: Deliver Useful Objects to Settler Ivanayus

start.text: Settler Dallanas is giving you a quizzical look. Talk to Settler Dallanas.

end.text: Settler Dallanas says the goddesses bless those who worship their statues. Worship the statue of Goddess Zemyna at the Randoluma Rest Place and receive Her blessings.
end.objective: Worship the Statue of Goddess Zemyna at the Randoluma Rest Place

start.text: Settler Dallanas seems worried about something. Talk to Settler Dallanas.

progress.text: Settler Dallanas was told to wait at the Randoluma Rest Place before coming to Orsha, but staying there proved impossible due to the amount of monsters. Go to the Randoluma Rest Place and defeat the monsters there.
progress.objective: Defeat Monsters at the Randoluma Rest Place

end.text: The Randoluma Rest Place is safer now. Go and tell Settler Dallanas.

start.text: Settler Dallanas seems anxious about something. Ask them what is wrong.

progress.text: Settler Dallanas says her people arrived at the Randoluma Rest Place but had to scatter because of the monsters. Go to Randoluma Rest Place and find the villagers hiding there.
progress.objective: Randoluma Rest Place

end.text: You have found the villagers and brought them back to safety. Tell Settler Dallanas.

start.text: The Lord of Orsha, Inesa Hamondale, wants you to hear about what is happening in Orsha before you start your journey. Talk to Inesa Hamondale about the situation in Orsha.

end.text: Inesa Hamondale has asked you to find the bishop of Orsha, Urbonas, who is missing. Talk to Inesa Hamondale again.

start.text: Inesa Hamondale seems to have something prepared for you before you set out to find Bishop Urbonas. Talk to Inesa Hamondale about it.

progress.text: Before you leave, Inesa Hamondale has asked you to worship the statue of Goddess Ausrine in the Central Plaza.
progress.objective: Worship the Statue of Goddess Ausrine in the Central Plaza

end.text: Inesa Hamondale has prepared a little gift for you. Go see the Item Merchant in the Shopping District.
end.objective: Visit the Item Merchant in the Shopping District

start.text: It seems the Item Merchant has something else to ask you. Talk to the Item Merchant again.

end.text: It seeems Inesa Hamondale has asked the Accessory Merchant to prepare another gift for you. Go find the Accessory Merchant in the Shopping District.

start.text: The Item Merchant says Inesa Hamondale is looking for you. Return to Inesa Hamondale.

end.text: News just came in from Informer Cherasia, who is searching for the missing bishop. Go find the informer in the Woods of the Linked Bridges.
end.objective: Talk to Informer Cherasia at the Woods of the Linked Bridges

start.text: Informer Cherasia seems to have found some revealing contents in Priest Irma's diary. Take the diary to

progress.text: Protect Informer Moren while he investigates. The more monsters you defeat in the area, the faster the informer will finish his investigation.
progress.objective: Help Informer Moren

end.text: Informer Moren's investigation is now complete. Ask him whether he has found anything.

start.text: Informer Moren seems to be pondering something. Keep talking to him.

progress.text: Informer Moren is convinced there might be other clues around. Look for leads in piles of grass with smoke coming out.
progress.objective: Collect clues from the Smoking Piles of Grass

end.text: You have collected a good amount of clues. Bring them to Informer Moren.

start.text: Informer Moren thinks Priest Pranas might know something about the clues found here. Tracer Ulysses and Priest Pranas are traveling upwards; go and meet them.

progress.text: Priest Pranas instructed Tracer Ulysses to investigate, but he finds it difficult because of the monsters. Go and investigate the Great Stone Face Hill for them.
progress.objective: Investigate the Great Stone Face Hill

end.text: An unknown diary was found in the tent destroyed by the Minotaur. Read what it says.

start.text: The diary belongs to the missing Bishop Urbonas. Bring the diary to Tracer Ulysses.

end.text: Tracer Ulysses is worried about the demons and thinks it's best for you to go and help Priest Pranas instead. Go to Paupys Crossing and talk to Tracer Talbasi, who is there investigating with Priest Pranas.{nl}
end.objective: Talk to Tracer Talbasi at Paupys Crossing

start.text: Informer Pierneef looks extremely worn out. Try and talk to Informer Pierneef.

progress.text: Informer Pierneef is helping other informers investigate the area. Defeat some monsters at the Zbuka Inner Court.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters at the Zbuka Inner Court

end.text: The area seems safer now. Report back to Informer Pierneef.

start.text: A nauseating smell permeates the air all around. Ask Informer Pierneef about it.

progress.text: Informer Pierneef says the smell of defeated monsters is making other monsters go wild. Go to the Zbuka Inner Court and eliminate the smelly cart there.
progress.objective: 악취나는 수레 처리

end.text: You have burned down the smelly cart. Go and tell Informer Pierneef.

start.text: Tracer Germeja is happy to see you. Talk to Tracer Germeja.

progress.text: Tracer Germeja wants to give the monsters a stimulant drug that makes them fight each other. Use the stimulant on monsters.
progress.objective: Use the stimulant on the monsters

end.text: The stimulant works perfectly. Go and talk to Tracer Germeja again.

start.text: Tracer Raitis looks worryingly livid. Ask Tracer Raitis if there is a problem.

end.text: Tracer Raitis says they saw an unknown monster making a nest at Bonan Forest Road. Go destroy the nest and defeat some monsters there.
end.objective: Defeat the monsters at Bonan Forest Road

start.text: You have defeated the monsters in Bonan Forest Road. Keep going and destroy the unknown monster nest.
start.objective: Destroy the Monster Nest in Bonan Forest Road

end.text: You have successfully destroyed the nest. Go and tell Tracer Raitis.

60099.name: Large-Scale Search Operation (1)
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: You now have Priest Gelija's notes, but an important part seems to have been torn off. Ask Tracer Talbasi about what to do next.

end.text: Tracer Talbasi believes it's best to obtain more concrete clues before finding Priest Pranas. They asked you to search the recently discovered Paslaptis Hideout before meeting up with Agent Larena.

start.text: There was nothing but traces of hurried movements at the Paslaptis Hideout. To continue investigating, go talk to Agent Larena under the Watchtower.

progress.text: Agent Larena believes Bishop Urbonas and the priests are on the move not because of a simple threat, but with a specific purpose. Take Jolly, a dog raised by the priests, and try to find their traces nearby.
progress.objective: Find the priests' traces with Jolly

end.text: Thanks to Jolly you were able to find traces of the priests. Go and talk to Larena again.

start.text: Agent Larena seems to have hear something. Ask Agent Larena what happened.

end.text: Tracer Sendal looks gravely injured. Talk to Tracer Sendal and find out what happened.

start.text: Tracer Sendal was waiting for help. Talk to Tracer Sendal and find out what happened.

progress.text: Tracer Sendal and Priest Pranas encountered some demons while investigating Groundsle Hill. Tracer Sendal now wants you to help rescue Priest Pranas from the demons.
progress.objective: Rescue Priest Pranas from the demons at Groundsle Hill

end.text: You finally rescued Priest Pranas. Ask Priest Pranas if he is alright.

start.text: Agent Notres looks furious. Ask Agent Notres what is wrong.

end.text: Agent Notres thinks it doesn't make sense to move the people migrating to Orsha to the Deer Hooves Lot. First, they want you to check whether it would be possible to defeat the monsters there.
end.objective: Defeat the monsters at the Deer Hooves Lot

start.text: Agent Notres has asked you to check whether the Deer Hooves Lot can be used to make a temporary settler camp. Go there and see whether it is safe.
start.objective: Check out at the Deer Hooves Lot

end.text: The Deer Hooves Lot doesn't seem like a safe place for the settlers. Go and tell Agent Notres about it.

start.text: Tracer Zegaus needs your help. Talk to Agent Zegaus.

progress.text: While Tracer Zegaus is glad Priest Pranas is safe, now they are injured and worried for their own safety. Defeat some monsters for Zegaus.
progress.objective: Defeat the nearby monsters

end.text: The monsters won't be a threat now. Return to Tracer Zegaus.

start.text: Tracer Zegaus looks troubled by something. Ask Tracer Zegaus what is wrong.

progress.text: Tracer Zegaus seems to have lost a bag with medicine and bandages. Look around and search for the trackers' belongings.
progress.objective: Collect Tracer Zegaus' Belongings

end.text: You have found the trackers' belongings. Bring them to Tracer Zegaus.

start.text: Inesa Hamondale is deeply worried after hearing about Bishop Urbonas being chased by demons. Talk to Inesa Hamondale about what to do next.

end.text: Inesa Hamondale prepared a quick gift that will be useful for your journey. Before departing for Ashaq Underground Prison, visit the Item Merchant to collect it.

start.text: If you are ready, go join Priest Pranas before leaving for the Ashaq Underground Prison to rescue Bishop Urbonas.

end.text: Priest Pranas says he is going to gather a few talented tracers and head to the entrance of Ashaq Underground Prison. Join him by the Gebene Cliff in Paupys Crossing.

start.text: With the cursed idol destroyed, the curse on Ashaq Underground Prison 1F seems to have been lifted. Return to Priest Pranas.

end.text: With the cursed idol destroyed, the curse on Ashaq Underground Prison 1F seems to have been lifted. Return to Priest Pranas.

start.text: Bishop Urbonas says he is hiding in the Ashaq Underground Prison to keep the Demon Orders from Marnox. Tell Bishop Urbonas about the nightmare.

progress.text: Bishop Urbonas wonders if you're not a Revelator as the ones told in the legends yourself. Step on the Revelator magic circle to prove your identity as a Revelator.
progress.objective: Check the magic circle

end.text: A bright light twines around your body and you feel an inexplicable surge of divine force. Talk to Bishop Urbonas again.

start.text: Bishop Urbonas has asked you to retrieve the hidden Demon Orders. Talk to him again and find out what you need to do.

progress.text: According to Urbonas, to destroyed the cursed idol you need to defeat demons in Ashaq Underground Prison 1F and recharge the Orb of Return, then use it on the cursed idol.
progress.objective: Defeat demons to recharge the Orb of Return

end.text: You have recharged the Orb of Return. Use it on the cursed idol to destroy it!
end.objective: Destroy the Cursed Idol in the Torture Material Room

60122.name: Blackmail
task: Collect Red Essence by defeating Blue Dumaros and Blue Wendigos (0 / 7)
Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

60124.name: Unidentified Package (1)
task: Collect Unidentified Package by defeating Blue Dumaros and Blue Wendigos (0 / 7)
Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: You have collected enough unidentified packages. Use them on monsters to see what effect they possess.
start.objective: Use the Unidentified Packages to see their effect

end.text: The packages possess not a curse, but a series of beneficial effects. Go and tell Chaser Daramaus about the packages' effects.

start.text: Priest Pranas is still searching for Bishop Urbonas. Go immediately and tell him about Bishop Urbonas.

end.text: The tracers have not yet recovered from the effects of the curse. Follow Priest Pranas into Ashaq Underground Prison 2F.
end.objective: Follow Priest Pranas into Ashaq Underground Prison 2F

start.text: Priest Irma believes it's best to find a way to safely destroy the cursed idol, as the orb is not yet completed. Keep talking to Priest Irma.

progress.text: For the cursed idol to be safely destroyed, its energy needs to clash with the orb's power. First, defeat demons around the idol in the Examination Room and have it absorb their power.
progress.objective: Absorb demon magic into the Cursed Idol

end.text: The cursed idol has fully absorbed the demons' power. Use the Orb of Return to destroy the idol!
end.objective: Destroy the Cursed Idol with the Orb of Return

start.text: There seems to be another cursed idol in Ashaq Underground Prison 2F. Keep talking to Priest Pranas.

progress.text: Priest Pranas heard about what happened to Priest Irma from the other priests. Rescue Priest Irma from the Solitary Confinement District.
progress.objective: Rescue Priest Irma from the Solitary Confinement District

end.text: You have defeated the Fire Lord summoned by Demon Lord Marnox. Ask Priest Irma if she is all right.

start.text: Priest Irma was about to hand over the Orb of Return to destroy the cursed idol when she noticed something odd. Talk to Priest Irma.

progress.text: Priest Irma says the Orb of Return is heavily damaged from having used it on Demon Lord Marnox. To fix the Orb of Return, defeat Wendigo Escapees nearby the Central Passage and use their magic energy to restore the Orb of Return.
progress.objective: Defeat Wendigo Escapees and charge the Orb of Return

end.text: You have infused the orb with the Wendigo Escapees' magic power. Show the Orb of Return to Priest Irma again.

start.text: Priest Irma says the Orb of Return needs a charge of divine power to fully recover. Ask Priest Irma how to do that.

progress.text: Priest Irma wants you to charge the orb with power from the crystals in the Bird Room and the Supply Room. Walk near the crystals to have it absorb their power.
progress.objective: Strengthen the Orb with the Crystal's Power

end.text: The orb seems to be somewhat restored. Show it to Priest Irma.

start.text: You have successfully destroyed the Cursed Idol. Go and tell Priest Irma.

end.text: Priest Irma believes it's time to take back the Demon Orders and has asked you to meet her at Ashaq Underground Prison 3F.
end.objective: Talk to Priest Irma at Ashaq Underground Prison 3F

start.text: It looks like Priest Auranas needs your help. Talk to Priest Auranas.

progress.text: Under the instruction of Bishop Urbonas, Priest Auranas has several emergency items prepared all around Ashaq Underground Prison. Go to the Watchtower and retrieve the shiny pearl powder left there by Auranas.
progress.objective: Collect Twinkling Pearl Powder

end.text: Despite the bag being torn you managed to collect what is left of the pearl powder. Bring it to Priest Auranas.

start.text: Priest Auranas has created a sort of orb with the pearl powder you have collected. Talk to Priest Auranas again.

progress.text: According to Priest Auranas, using this orb will point out high-rank demons. Use the orb and defeat the demons signaled by it.
progress.objective: Defeat the demons marked by the Orb

end.text: The demon subordinates look confused without their superiors around. Report to Priest Auranas.

start.text: Priest Draznie looks deep in worry. Talk to Priest Draznie.

progress.text: Priest Draznie is looking for a safe place for the priests to take refuge. Defeat the monsters in the Special Prison District to make it a safe shelter for the priests.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters in the Special Prison District

end.text: You have defeated enough demons. Go and tell Priest Draznie.

start.text: Priest Draznie requires your help. Talk to Priest Draznie.

progress.text: Priest Draznie thinks it's time to use the trap prepared by Priest Auranas. Your job is to lure the demons into the trap set up in the Solitary Cells area, where they should be easily defeated.
progress.objective: 함정으로 마족 유인

end.text: You have defeated the demons with ease thanks to the trap. Tell Priest Draznie about it.

start.text: Priest Irma says there is another cursed idol here. Keep talking to Priest Irma.

progress.text: Priest Irma wants to release the spirit of the closest altar to clear out the energy of the cursed idol. With the power of the Revelators, release the spirit on your way to the Second Watchtower.
progress.objective: Release the Altar Spirit on your way to the Second Watchtower

end.text: You have released the spirit of the altar. Return to Priest Irma.

start.text: The demons have noticed the altar spirit, but it is not enough to interfere with the energy of the cursed idol. Talk to Priest Irma again.

progress.text: Priest Irma believes your only hope lies on the blessing spirit of the last remaining altar. Release the spirit bestowed on the Confession Altar in the Prayer Room.
progress.objective: Release the Altar Spirit in the Prayer Room

end.text: You have released the altar spirit. Ask Priest Irma whether the curse of the idol was lifted.

start.text: Priest Irma can feel that the curse of the idol is being dispelled. Keep talking to Priest Irma.

progress.text: Priest Irma believes the Idol will have become completely harmless now. Go to the Second Watchtower and destroy the cursed idol.
progress.objective: Destroy the Cursed Idol in the Second Watchtower

end.text: The demons standing guard on the cursed idol attacked, but you managed to successfully destroy it. Return to Priest Irma.

start.text: With the cursed idol destroyed, you should be able to search for the hidden Demon Orders now. Talk to Priest Irma.

progress.text: Demon Lord Marnox was hiding in the Penitence Room waiting to attack you! Defeat Demon Lord Marnox.
progress.objective: 마군주 마르녹스 처치

end.text: You have defeated Demon Lord Marnox. Ask Priest Irma if she is all right.

start.text: You have recovered the Demon Orders, but Priest Irma's condition has suffered. Talk to Priest Irma.

end.text: Priest Irma wants you to go and deliver the Demon Orders to Bishop Urbonas. Bring the orders to the room in Ashaq Underground Prison 1F where Bishop Urbonas is hiding.
end.objective: Deliver to Priest Urbonas at Ashaq Underground Prison 1F

start.text: Bishop Urbonas cannot hide his surprise at the fact that you defeated Marnox. Keep talking to Bishop Urbonas.

end.text: Bishop Urbonas believes the Lord of Orsha, Inesa Hamondale, will be worried about him. Return to Orsha and talk to Inesa Hamondale.
end.objective: Return to Orsha and talk to Inesa Hamondale

start.text: Priest Gelija seems to have something to ask of you. Talk to Priest Gelija.

progress.text: Priest Gelija is trying to help the injured but it seems they lost a pouch with medicine while running away. Find Priest Gelija's medicine pouch.
progress.objective: Retrieve Priest Gelija's Medicine Pouch

end.text: You have found Priest Gelija's medicine pouch. Bring it to Priest Gelija.

start.text: Priest Gelija is looking for a helping hand. Talk to Priest Gelija.

progress.text: While the cursed idol has been destroyed, its future still worries Priest Gelija. Cover any idol fragments with the cloth soaked in holy water to clear out their evil energy.
progress.objective: Purify the Cursed Idol with the Holy Water Cloth

end.text: A lot of the evil energy has now been purified. Return to Priest Gelija.

start.text: Inesa Hamondale, Lord of Orsha, is honored to meet a Revelator. Keep talking to Inesa Hamondale.

end.text: Inesa Hamondale has asked you to return to Bishop Urbonas. Go see Bishop Urbonas and hear about the contents of the Demon Orders.

start.text: Check the Purifier in Crystal Mine 3F

progress.text: The purifier on the 3rd floor is disabled for lack of energy. Find magic crystals and charge the emergency power source with their magic, then use it to provide energy to the 3F Purifier.
progress.objective: Collect Crystal Magic

end.text: You have collected enough crystal magic. Supply their energy to the 3F Purifier.

start.text: Watcher Molly is waiting for your help at Srautas Gorge

progress.text: Watcher Molly believes the reason the Pantos started acting strange from eating the Plateau Sugar Beets. She requested you get destroy all the Plateau Sugar Beets.
progress.objective: Remove the Plateau Sugar Beet Stems

end.text: You have removed enough Plateau Sugar Beets. Report to Watcher Molly.

start.text: Watcher Molly is waiting for help at the Gele Plateau

progress.text: Watcher Molly wants to gather information on the monsters in order to more effectively use a shaman doll at Gele Plateau. Defeat Spion Archers, Leaflies and Malis to learn how to handle these new monsters.
progress.objective: Hunt Monsters

end.text: You have collected sufficient information for Watcher Molly. Go back and report to her about what you learned fighting the monsters.

start.text: Priest Draznie is looking for help in Ashaq Underground Prison 2F

progress.text: Priest Draznie has asked you to collect some traps she set up a long time ago. According to her, most traps are set up in the Waiting Room and the Supply Room.
progress.objective: Collect Faulty Traps

end.text: You have collected a large number of traps. Bring them to Priest Draznie.
end.objective: Return the Faulty Traps to Priest Draznie

start.text: Priest Gelija is waiting for help in Ashaq Underground Prison 3F

progress.text: Priest Gelija has asked you to clear out the Varvs that have been terrorizing the priests in Ashaq Underground Prison. They are often found at the Felon Prison.
progress.objective: Varv Extermination

end.text: You have clear out enough Varvs. Report to Gelija.

start.text: A traveling merchant in Koru Jungle is waiting for help

progress.text: The merchant wants to retrieve some blue coal they buried in Koru Jungle to help them make it through until the group has recovered. Go to Goram Shores and Saunu Brook and find the pieces of blue coal in the piles of dirt.
progress.objective: Collect Blue Coal

end.text: You have collected enough blue coal. Deliver it to the merchant.
end.objective: Deliver the Blue Coal to the merchant

start.text: Check for requests at the Mercenary Post.
start.objective: Check for requests at the Mercenary Post

progress.text: You've accepted a mission from receptionist Donnes at the Mercenary Post. Complete the mission.
progress.objective: Carry out the Mercenary Post Mission

end.text: You've completed the mission. Report back to Donnes at the Mercenary Post.
end.objective: Report to the Mercenary Post Receptionist

progress.objective: Check the experiment's result with Druid Ellie

task: Obtain Tama Body Fluid from Tamas (0 / 20)

start.text: It seems that Druid Ellie has a last request. Talk to Druid Ellie.

end.text: Druid Ellie told you hand over a box to Druid Martinek at Shaton Farm. Find a person who is likely to know the whereabouts of Druid Martinek.
end.objective: Look for a person who is likely to know the whereabouts of Martinek at Shaton Farm

70006.name: It's All Over Now
task: Defeat Orange Lizardmen at Abandoned Grape Farm (0 / 15)

start.text: Farmer Darcy needs your help. Talk to Farmer Darcy.

progress.text: Farmer Darcy told you that he can't harvest crops due to the Lizardmen. Reduce the number of the monsters for Farmer Darcy.
progress.objective: Defeat Orange Lizardmen

end.text: You've reduced the number of Lizardmen. Talk to Farmer Darcy again.

start.text: Farmer Darcy still has some complaints. Listen to his complaints.

progress.text: Farmer Darcy told you that the dandelions are sprouting irregularly, but he can't pull them out due to the monsters. Eliminate the young dandelions for him.
progress.objective: Get rid of the young dandelions

end.text: You've pulled out all the young dandelions. Talk to Farmer Darcy again.

70008.name: Unreliable Folk
task: Defeat Orange Lizardmen at Ziura Crossroads (0 / 12)

start.text: Farmer Miren seems to have lots of complaints. Talk to Farmer Miren

progress.text: Farmer Miren is complaining that the druids just sit and watch a tree while many monsters roam about. Defeat Orange Lizardmen for Farmer Miren.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters nearby

end.text: You've defeated many monsters nearby. Return to Farmer Miren

start.text: You have completed all the requests of Farm Supervisor Dorn. Ask him again the whereabouts of the druid.

end.text: Dorn drove the druid deep into the farm. Go to Neshiva Road to find Druid Martinek.

start.text: Druid Martinek seems be in a hurry. You've found Druid Martinek as Druid Ellie requested. Talk to him.

progress.text: Druid Martinek told you that there are farmers who are exposed to the poison at Zirta Brewery and Gausa Workplace. Give them the antidote.
progress.objective: Cure the poisoned farmers

end.text: You have saved all the poisoned farmers. Return to Druid Martinek and tell him about it.

start.text: Since you've saved all the poisoned farmers, you can now continue with your original errand. Talk to Druid Martinek.

progress.text: Reduce the HP of the winged frog and use the controlling stick to take it to Druid Martinek.
progress.objective: Bring winged frogs with the help of the obedience stick

end.text: You handed over enough frogs to Druid Martinek. Talk to Druid Martinek.

70025.name: Old Seeds (2)
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: You are now ready to restore the old seeds. Talk to Druid Martinek.

end.text: Druid Martinek told you that he will try persuading the owner of the farm, Gord Shaton, to plant the seeds. Meet Druid Martinek at the Shaton Reservoir.
end.objective: Go to the reservoir district of Shaton

start.text: Farm Soldier Gedson is mad at you. Talk to him to find out.

progress.text: Gedson told you to help him, or else you can't enter the farm without his permission. Defeat the nearby Cysts.
progress.objective: Defeat Cysts

end.text: You've defeated all the Cysts. Tell Farm Soldier Gedson.

start.text: Farm Soldier Gedson still has some tasks to request of you. Talk to Gedson again.

progress.text: Farm Soldier Gedson is hoping to eliminate the Orange Stumpy Trees. Rid the farm of Orange Stumpy Trees.
progress.objective: Eliminate the Orange Stumpy Trees

end.text: You have eliminated all of the Orange Stumpy Trees. Inform Farm Soldier Gedson.

end.text: 이 정도면 충분한 것 같습니다. 캐터프랙트 마스터에게 돌아가 보고하세요.

progress.text: 보코르 서브 마스터는 보스 몬스터에게 얻을 수 있는 카드를 가져 오라고 합니다.
progress.objective: Collect Boss Monster Card

end.text: 보스 몬스터 카드를 얻었습니다. 보코르 서브 마스터에게 카드를 전해 주세요.

start.text: 오르샤에서 사두 마스터의 유체와 대화하세요.

progress.text: The Sadhu Master has given you a task. Go to Feretory Hills and imbue monsters with the Sadhu Master's spirit, then defeat them and collect their souls. This task you must complete on your own.
progress.objective: Collect monster souls imbued with the Sadhu Master's spirit

end.text: You have completed the Sadhu Master's task. Return to the Sadhu Master's physical body in Orsha.

start.text: Talk with Barbarian Submaster at Paupys Crossing

progress.text: This is the last test of the Barbarian. Drink this Barbarian medicinal liquid and defeat the monsters at Apsimesti Crossroads while your body is under the influence. You have to finish this test by yourself.
progress.objective: Drink the medicinal fluid and defeat the monsters at Apsimesti Crossroads

end.text: You've overcame the extreme hardship. Report back to Barbarian Submaster.

start.text: Talk with Rodelero Master at Orsha.

progress.objective: Defeat the monsters at Apsimesti Crossroads without a shield

end.text: You've been proven to be strong without relying on the shield. Go back to Rodelero Master and report.

start.text: Talk with Catapract Master at Orsha.

progress.objective: Defeat monsters at Apsimesti Crossroads while mounting on a Companion

end.text: You have completed the test. Report back to the Cataphract Master.

start.text: Talk with Bokor Submaster at Orsha

start.text: Talk with the spirit of Sadhu Master at Orsha

progress.text: The Sadhu Master asked you to defeat the monsters that are threatening the villagers. Defeat Red Tree Ambulos from Apsimesti Crossroads.
progress.objective: Defeat Red Tree Ambulos at Apsimesti Crossroads

end.text: You've defeated all monsters that threaten the villagers. Go back to the spirit of Sadhu Master in Orsha and report.

progress.objective: Defeat the monsters who are attracted to the relic.

end.text: Defeated Gaigalas. Report to the Cataphract Master.

start.text: Mage Melchioras seems to have something to say to you. Talk to Mage Melchioras.

end.text: After hearing that you're a Revelator, Mage Melchioras seems to want to tell you something. Listen to what he has to say.

start.text: Mage Melchioras says he has returned to this place to gather the Revelators and stop another Kruvina from being created in Delmore Castle. Keep listening to Mage Melchioras.

progress.text: You have decided to help Melchioras. Visit the spots marked on the map and use the compass to find the objects under the protection cast. The compass is activated only near the cast.
progress.objective: Use the compass to search for hidden artifacts

end.text: You have found the objects under the protection cast. Relay their location to Mage Melchioras.

start.text: Melchioras is going to analyze the protection spell; meanwhile, talk to Revelator Mihail.

progress.text: According to Mihail, they need more magic concentration orbs to blast the Magic Power Supply Device. Defeat demons to charge the orbs.
progress.objective: Defeat demons and charge the Magic Concentration Orbs

end.text: You have filled all orbs with magic. Bring them to Revelator Mihail.

start.text: Mage Melchioras' analysis of the protection spell seems to have come to an end. Talk to Mage Melchioras.

progress.text: Mage Melchioras has asked you to dispel the protection spell placed north of the Amjene Sanctum. Use the amulet on the objects protected by the cast to release it.
progress.objective: Release the objects' protection spell

end.text: You have dispelled the protection spell. Return to Mage Melchioras.

70404.name: Destroy the Magic Power Supply Device

start.text: All preparations for blowing up the Magic Power Supply Device are now in place. Talk to Mage Melchioras.

progress.text: It's time to blow up the Magic Power Supply Device. Go to the Ishinti Crossroads and place the charged orbs around the device.
progress.objective: Place the Magic Concentration Orbs on the Magic Power Supply Device

end.text: All the charged orbs are now in place. Talk to Revelator Mihail and blow up the Magic Power Supply Device.

required_quests.name: Destroy the Demonic Power Supply Device

end.text: Melchioras wants to meet up at Delmore Manor, where the Kruvina device is located. Join Mage Melchioras at Delmore Manor.

progress.text: Follower Andrea is looking to obtain information on Pag Amplers. Defeat Pag Amplers and collect any data you can from them.
progress.objective: Collect data from Pag Amplers

end.text: You have collected enough data. Bring it to Follower Andrea.

progress.text: Follower Andrea was asked to contact a resident of Delmore Castle named Ardel, but all Delmore Castle residents are missing. Try and recover Ardel's diary.
progress.objective: Collect the diary of Delmore Castle resident Ardel

end.text: You have collected all the pages of the diary. Bring them to Follower Andrea.

progress.objective: Defeat nearby demons

progress.objective: Cremate the resurrected dead

start.text: The Elgos Monk is looking for a way to remove all the vines grown by Dominikas. Talk to Lucienne Winterspoon to get the info you need.

progress.text: Lucienne Winterspoon has developed new reagent. She combined materials in accordance with the adivice from Vaidotas. The result was a safe reagent.
progress.objective: Remove the vines by using Lucienne's Special Reagent

end.text: The vines wither away from a mere touch of Lucienne's special reagent.

start.text: The Elgos Monk is in need of your help. Talk to him.

progress.text: The monk wants retrieve the fake scripture spread by Dominikas. Inspect the bookpiles in Veyrhas Hall.
progress.objective: Retrieve the fake scripture

end.text: You've found the fake scripture from the pile. Return it to the Elgos Monk.

start.text: According to the order of the Order of the Tree of Truth, they trapped the monk in the principal building. Find the trapped monk.

end.text: You've found the monk trapped in the Principal Laboratory. Talk to him.

end.text: The Elgos Monk says that the abbot is in the same situation as he was, trapped in the Monastery Courtyard. Get the food to him as well.

80092.name: The Corrupted Spirit of the Demons (1)

start.text: Found the abbot trapped in the Monastery Courtyard. Talk to him.

progress.text: The abbot claims that in order to destroy the black wall, the Sinister Idol must be destroyed as well. Fill the Soul Sphere with the demon souls, purify them to destroy the sinister idol.
progress.objective: Collect Demon Souls

end.text: You've filled the Soul Sphere with the demon souls. Return to the Elgos Abbot.

start.text: You've purchased Holy Water from the Priest Master. Talk to the Elgos Abbot.

progress.text: The abbot purified the soul sphere. He says using the purified soul sphere will destroy the sinister idol.
progress.objective: Destroy the Sinister Idol

end.text: By using the soul sphere, you've destroyed the sinister idol. Report back to the Elgos Abbot.

required_quests.name: The Corrupted Spirit of the Demons (3)

start.text: You've destroyed the sinister idol by using the purified soul sphere. Talk to the Elgos Abbot.

progress.text: The Elgos abbot says that Dominikas frequently visited the Pagarba Chapel. Hiding inside it, he will certainly show his face there. Move to the Pagarba Chapel.
progress.objective: Move to the Pagarba Chapel

end.text: The magic must have failed since no plant multiplied. Instead, gluttons appeared and you've barely managed to defeat it. Report this to the Elgos Abbot.

start.text: You've successfully driven out Dominikas and rescued the abbot.

progress.text: The Elgos Abbot requested your help in resolving misunderstandings the townspeople have. Go along with the abbot to resolve the misunderstanding.
progress.objective: Resolve the misunderstanding of the townspeople with the Elgos Abbot

end.text: The townspeople seemed to have realized the truth at the Annex Laboratory. Talk to the Elgos Abbot.

80098.name: The power that was prepared for the future

start.text: The Elgos Abbot seems to want to ask you a favor. Talk to him.

progress.text: The abbot says that to prevent it from ever happening again, the abbot asks you to filled up the soul sphere with the demon souls once again.
progress.objective: Defeat the demons and absorb their fallen souls

end.text: You've successfully filled the soul sphere up. Return to the abbot.

start.text: You have arrived at Vera Coast. What kind of events could await you here?

progress.text: A magic circle under your feet has suddenly activated and you're unable to move! First, defeat the monsters around you.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters that are rushing in

end.text: Someone seems to have created a magic circle with evil intents. Look for other magic circles around Vera Coast.

start.text: The stones don't seem to be very effective. Look for another solution.
start.objective: Find another way to destroy the magic circles

progress.text: The stones don't seem to be very effective. Defeat nearby monsters to obtain a piece of monster horns and throw it.
progress.objective: Throw a piece of Coral Horn

end.text: You have destroyed the Blue and Red Magic Circles. Look for any other magic circles.

start.text: Kabbalist Lutas has disabled the Binding Magic Circle that was trapping you. Ask him what happened.

progress.text: Kabbalist Lutas is redrawing the magic circles stabilizing Vera Coast. Go with him to the magic circle he is redrawing.
progress.objective: Go to the Magic Circle with Kabbalist Lutas

end.text: The magic circles thought to have been created with evil intentions were drawn by Lutas. Talk to him.

start.text: It looks like you will have to help Lutas redraw the magic circles. Talk to him.

progress.text: Kabbalist Lutas has asked you to fill the magic stone with earth energy. Go to the Tuolo Coral Reef and have the stone absorb earth energy. Lutas also warned you to be careful of any monsters after earth energy.
progress.objective: Gather Earth Energy

end.text: You have gather enough earth energy. Return to Kabbalist Lutas.

start.text: Kabbalist Lutas says the Earth Magic Circle is not yet complete. Ask him if there is anything you can help with meanwhile.

end.text: Kabbalist Lutas now wants to collect energy to repair the water and Balancing Magic Circles. Put down the Balancing Magic Stone and defeat nearby monsters to collect sea and earth energy.

start.text: You have filled the Balancing Magic Stone with balancing energy. Now fill the Sea Magic Stone with sea energy.

end.text: You have filled the Balancing and Sea Magic Stones with sufficient energy. Return to Kabbalist Lutas.

start.text: Kabbalist Lutas is going to head to the spot where the Sea Magic Circle is. Go meet him there.

progress.text: Kabbalist Lutas wants to draw the next magic circle as soon as possible. While he does that, he has asked you to protect him from nearby monsters.
progress.objective: Protect Lutas

end.text: Lutas has completed the Sea Magic Circle. Talk to him.

start.text: Lutas has restored the Sea Magic Circle. Talk to Lutas.

progress.text: Lutas says all that's left to do is repair the Balancing Magic Circle. Go with Lutas to the Bachl Vacant Lot, where the circle is.
progress.objective: Go to the Bachl Vacant Lot for the Last Magic Circle

end.text: Lutas seems to have been injured by the attacking Crabil. Talk to Lutas.

start.text: The Crabil was defeated, but Lutas seems to be injured. Talk to him.

progress.text: Lutas seems to be having trouble moving. You need to complete the Balancing Magic Circle for him. Defeat nearby monsters to keep them from disturbing you.
progress.objective: Add balancing energy to the magic circle

end.text: After adding the balancing energy to the magic circle, it is now completed. Return to Lutas.

start.text: Kabbalist Lutas seems to have something to ask you. Talk to him.

progress.text: Lutas thinks the earth energy gathered with the collector was too weak. Put down the Earth Magic Stone and defeat nearby monsters to fill it with earth energy. Like Lutas warned, make sure it doesn't mix with sea energy.
progress.objective: Gather Earth Energy

end.text: You have gathered earth energy from monsters. Return to Kabbalist Lutas.

start.text: Kabbalist Lutas seems to have something to ask you. Talk to him.

progress.text: Lutas wants to create Binding Magic Circles to protect the newly drawn ones. He believes the ones he created at first were too dangerous, as they worked on both monsters and humans, so he has given you a new magic circle scroll.
progress.objective: Create a Binding Magic Circle

end.text: You have created new magic circles around the newly drawn ones. Return to Lutas.

start.text: You have created new magic circles around the newly drawn ones. Talk to Lutas.

progress.text: Kabbalist Lutas wants to find and destroy the Binding Magic Circles he has previously created. Use Lutas' Magic Searching Stone to find the circles. Revealed magic circles disappear after some time, or you can lure monsters into them.
progress.objective: Search for dangerous Binding Magic Circles

end.text: You took care of all the dangerous magic circles. Talk to Lutas.

progress.objective: Put the Spiritual Stones at Alkune Stairway

start.text: You must enter the Crystal Mines but the Miners' Village, where the Crystal Mine is located, in under attack by the Vubbes. Go to the Miners' Village quickly!

start.text: As the goddess told you in the dream of the bishop, you should first go to Crystal Mine, but you can't just see and ignore the villagers who are evacuating. Let's help the angry hunter.

progress.text: The Hunter says that monsters stole all the relief supplies meant for the villagers. {nl}Try to pick up at least what's left on the road.
progress.objective: Aid Recovery

end.text: Gathered all the relief supplies. Talk to the Hunter.

start.text: You need to go to the Crystal Mine as told by the goddess in the bishop's dream but you can't just leave the refugees. Mine Manager Brinker is standing by the wall with one hand on the wall. Ask what is happening.

progress.text: The wall may collapse if Brinker releases his hands off the wall. Let's look for some rocks nearby to block the holes on the wall for Brinker.
progress.objective: Collect Reinforcement Stones from the rubbles nearby

end.text: Give the stones you collected to Brinker.
end.objective: Give the Reinforcement Stones to Brinker

start.text: Repaired the wall but Brinker still looks anxious. Talk to him.

progress.text: Defeat the monsters nearby so that Brinker can return safely.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters nearby

end.objective: Tell Brinker that it is safe

start.text: You need to go to the Crystal Mines as told by the goddess in the bishop's dream but you can't just leave the refugees. Help the Healer Lady to treat the injured people.

progress.text: Healer Lady is asking a favor for you to bring the other refugees. Bring the couple near the Statue of Goddess Zemyna to the Healer Lady.
progress.objective: Bring the refugees

end.text: Brought back the refugees safely. Talk to the Healer Lady.
end.objective: Turn over the refugees to the Healer Lady

start.text: Tell the Healer Lady to go back to the village again.

progress.text: The lady says she can't go back with her patients because there are too many monsters. Defeat the monsters for her.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters

end.text: Defeated the monsters. Tell the lady to go back to the village.

start.text: The Mayor seems to have a problem. Talk to him.
start.objective: Talk to the Miners' Village Mayor

progress.text: Vubbes are taking over the village! Let's drive them out.
progress.objective: Defeat the Vubbes who invaded the village

end.text: Seems like you drove out the Vubbes. Inform the Village Mayor about it.
end.objective: Talk to the Miners' Village Mayor

start.text: Talk to the mayor again to enter the Crystal Mines.
start.objective: Talk to the Miners' Village Mayor

progress.text: The goddess' revelation is important but you can't leave the kidnapped villagers. To save the villagers trapped in the Crystal Mine, go to the Vubbe Outpost and save Vaidotas first.
progress.objective: Rescue Vaidotas who is kidnapped by the Vubbes

end.text: You found Vaidotas. Discuss with him on how you can get into the Mines.

start.text: You need to remove the wagons in order to enter the mines. Talk to Vaidotas about how to remove them.

progress.text: Vaidotas says the wagons can be destroyed with explosives. But the Vubbes could attack when they hear the explosives, so you must be cautious.
progress.objective: Defeat any Vubbe that assembles after hearing the explosives

end.text: You removed the wagons and can finally enter the Crystal Mines. Meet Vaidotas at Crystal Mine 1F.
end.objective: Talk to Vaidotas in Crystal Mine 1F

start.text: There are many Owl Sculptures that guide souls in Kateen Forest. Listen to the story of the Weak Owl Sculpture.
start.objective: Talk to the Weak Owl Sculpture

end.objective: Talk to the Weak Owl Sculpture

start.text: &You can see an exhausted Officer Danus. Talk to him.

start.objective: Talk to the Weak Owl Sculpture

end.objective: Talk to the Weak Owl Sculpture

start.text: The souls that passed away sadly sleep at the Garden of Consolation near the Goddess Statue. Pray in front of the Goddess Statue and calm the souls.

progress.text: As you prayed in front of the goddess, the regretful souls started to gather toward the Goddess Statue! Protect these souls for a specified time frame.
progress.objective: Perform the Memorial Ceremony

start.text: There are many Owl Sculptures that guide souls in Kateen Forest. Listen to the story of the Shy Owl Sculpture.
start.objective: Talk to the Shy Owl Sculpture

progress.text: The Shy Owl told you that the souls that once followed its guidance stopped moving some time ago. Find out what happened to the souls and do something to make them move again.
progress.objective: Rescue the restrained souls

end.text: The souls were being tied with branches. By releasing the souls from the restraints, could you find out the origin of the evil energies? Talk to the Shy Owl again.
end.objective: Talk to the Shy Owl Sculpture

start.text: The restrained spirit is not the only one that is wandering. Listen for more details from the Sad Owl Sculpture.

progress.text: The Sad Owl Sculpture told you that something is wrong since the souls that went to see a Goddess Statue are suffering. Persuade the souls that are trying to go that Goddess Statue and take them to the Owl Sculpture.
progress.objective: Persuade the souls that lost their way

end.text: It seems that the Sad Owl Sculpture heard about what is happening to the souls. Return to the Sad Owl Sculpture and ask what happened.

start.text: The Sad Owl spoke with the souls. Talk to the Sad Owl again.

progress.text: The souls are claiming that the Goddess Statue at Amolallul Hill were calling them but, the Sad Owl told you that there isn't a statue there. Go to Amolallul Hill to find out exactly what happened.
progress.objective: Find out what happened at Amolallul Hill.

end.text: A Corrupted disguised itself as a Goddess Statue. Demons masquerading as goddesses are unforgivable. Return and report this to the Sad Owl.

start.text: Grita is waiting at the Karsta Hall Site of the Fedimian Suburbs. Talk to Grita.
start.objective: Talk to Grita at Fedimian Suburbs

end.text: Grita told you that the Goddess Gabija is resisting the attacks of the demons at the Mage Tower. Go to the Mage Tower to help the goddess.

start.text: You finally arrived inside the Mage Tower. Talk to Grita.
start.objective: Talk to Grita at Mage Tower 1F

progress.text: Grita told you that Gabija was protecting the tower, but since the monsters are still around, something bad must have happened to the goddess. Light up the signal at the left hallway to let the goddess know that you are here.
progress.objective: Light up the signal

end.text: You successfully lit up the signal. Talk to Grita again.

start.text: You lit up a signal to let the goddess know that help is coming. Discuss what to do next with Grita.

progress.text: Grita told you that using the Transport Magic Circle is the fastest way to go upstairs. Go to the 1st Transport Magic Circle to see whether it is working correctly.
progress.objective: Check the 1st Transport Magic Circle

end.text: You defeated the monsters that were rushing in and arrived at the place where the 1st Transport Magic Circle is located at. Talk to Grita.{nl}{nl}Grita finished checking the 1st Transport Magic Circle. Ask Grita if it works.

start.text: Grita's face turned grim as she was checking the Transport Magic Circle. Talk to Grita.

progress.text: Grita told you that the 1st Transport Magic Circle is badly broken and recommended to use the other, larger Transport Magic Circle. Look for the 2nd Transport Magic Circle and activate it.
progress.objective: Activate the 2nd Transport Magic Circle

end.text: You thought you could use the 2nd Transport Magic Circle, but there was a trap set by the demons. Talk to Grita again.

start.text: Grita told you that with the present danger, the plan to directly reach Goddess Gabija via the Transport Magic Circles should be abandoned, and you should focus on the monsters rushing into the tower. Talk to Grita for more details.

progress.text: Grita said in order to activate the Tower's Barrier Device again, it would need a great amount of energy. Set the gem Grita gave you on the ground and recharge the gem with the monsters' life force.
progress.objective: Charge the Absorbing Gem

end.text: You were able to charge the Absorbing Gem with monsters' life force. Return to Grita.

start.text: You recharged the gem with the monsters' life force. Talk to Grita about how to activate the Barrier Device

progress.text: The Barrier Device is located at the end of this left hallway. Activate the Barrier Device.
progress.objective: Activate the Barrier Device

end.text: You successfully activated the Barrier Device. Talk to Grita again.

8478.name: Mage Tower 2nd Floor (1)
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: You got the Jewel of Prominence. Talk to Grita about how you can input the power into the Jewel of Prominence.

progress.text: Grita told you that in order to complete the Jewel of Prominence, you should fill it with Flame Vapor. Fill it with the Flame Vapor that leaks in the Large Reading Room.
progress.objective: Collect Flame Vapor

end.text: You filled the Jewel of Prominence with Flame Vapor. Return to Grita.

start.text: You collected all the Flame Vapor. Ask Grita what to do next to complete the Jewel of Prominence.

progress.text: You should be able to gather the Essences of Fire when Flame Vapor is let out of the jewel. Fill the Jewel of Prominence with these essences.
progress.objective: Charge the Jewel

end.text: You filled the Jewel of Prominence with the Essence of Fire. Talk to Grita.

8481.name: Mage Tower 2nd Floor (4)
task: Get Flame Source from the monsters (0 / 11)
Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: Now, there is one more step to complete the Jewel of Prominence. Talk to Grita.

progress.text: Grita told you that since the Jewel of Prominence is not complete yet, you should combine materials with it in the Flame Fusion Machine. Combine the materials at the Flame Fusion Machine.
progress.objective: Combine materials with the Jewel of Prominence in the Flame Fusion Machine

end.text: You successfully completed the Jewel of Prominence. Talk to Grita.

start.text: Grita is waiting at the third floor of Mage Tower. Go to Grita.
start.objective: Talk to Grita at Mage Tower 3F

progress.text: It seems that the magician Antares is loose. Defeat the Red Infrorocktor that Antares has summoned.
progress.objective: Defeat Red Infrorocktors

end.text: You defeated the Red Infrorocktors which Antares summoned. Talk to Grita.

start.text: It was the mad magician, Antares who summoned the Krumadoks. Talk to Grita.

progress.text: Grita told you to break the Magic Control Valve to stop Antares. Destroy the valve at the Laboratory.
progress.objective: Destroy the first Magic Control Valve

end.text: As you destroyed the valve, it exploded. While it cleared away the monsters, it was really dangerous. Talk to Grita again.

start.text: There is a Mineloader at the Mage Tower that acts as a guard. Check the immobile Mineloader.

progress.text: Defeat the suddenly mobile Mineloader
progress.objective: Defeat the hostile Mineloader

start.text: Grita is waiting at the fourth floor of the Mage Tower. Go to Grita.
start.objective: Talk to Grita at Mage Tower 4F

progress.text: The Jewel of Prominence's status became abnormal since the Antares incident on the 3rd floor. Check its status as you defeat the monsters nearby.
progress.objective: Defeat monsters and watch the state of the Jewel of Prominence.

end.text: You felt the power of flames as you defeated the monsters. Talk to Grita.

start.text: The Jewel of Prominence is stabilized but the explosion at the 3rd Floor has made the Mage Tower unstable. Go to the Magic Control Room to control the disrupted magic of the Tower.

progress.text: Grita said we have to go to the Magic Control Room. Protect Grita while she stabilizes the magic.
progress.objective: Protect Grita while she is stabilizing the magic.

end.text: You defeated all the monsters, but the Tower is still shaking. Ask Grita what to do next.

8492.name: Mage Tower 4th Floor (5)
task: Defeat Grinender that is blocking the way to the 5th Floor (0 / 1)

start.text: Defeated all the monsters that threatened Grita. Ask Grita what to do next.

progress.text: Grita told you to give the Jewel of Prominence to the goddess while she takes care of the tower. Go to the 5th floor of the Mage Tower where the goddess is located.
progress.objective: Go to Mage Tower 5F

start.text: Helgasercle created Magic Suppressors on the 5th floor to weaken the Mage Tower's power. Destroy the 1st Suppressor located at the Hall of Fire.
Helgasercle created Magic Suppressors on the 5th floor to weaken the Mage Tower's power. Destroy the 2nd Suppressor located at the Reception Room.
Helgasercle created Magic Suppressors on the 5th floor to weaken the Mage Tower's power. Destroy the 3rd Suppressor located at the Small Hall.
Helgasercle created Magic Suppressors on the 5th floor to weaken the Mage Tower's power. Destroy the 4th Suppressor at the Reading Room.
You destroyed all four Magic Suppressors that Helgasercle prepared. It is now time to liberate the Mage Tower from the demon's powers. Find Helgasercle at the Great Hall.
You should help Gabija now with the Jewel of Prominence. Put the jewels in the center of Keturidu great hall.

end.text: You received the revelation from the goddess.{nl}Ask the goddess what to do next.

start.text: Now it's time to destroy the 2nd Valve. Talk to Grita.

progress.text: Grita told you that the 2nd Valve is in the Central Control Room. Go to the Central Control Room.
progress.objective: Find the 2nd Valve in the Central Control Room

end.text: Antares touched the wrong part of the valve, so the valve exploded. Talk to Grita.

start.text: The Barrier Activation Device is an important piece of equipment that protects the Mage Tower. Carefully inspect it.

end.text: The Salamander suddenly disappeared as you tried to inspect the Barrier Activation Device.

start.text: &The Flame Fusion Machine in Mage Tower 2F has a function to enhance the power of the flame. Check the Flame Fusion Machine.

end.text: &Archon appeared as you were checking the Flame Fusion Machine. Defeat Archon.

start.text: The Essence of Light is ready. Talk to Follower Vaidutis.

end.text: Vaidutis told you to use the Light Crystal to release the demonic barrier at the church's entrance. Powerful monsters will be attracted to the power of the Light Crystal and may attack you, so he told you to be careful.

start.text: Goddess Gabija says you need to strengthen your powers at the Entrance of Kateen Forest. Pass through Tenet Garden and go to the Entrance of Kateen Forest.
start.objective: Move to Entrance of Kateen Forest

end.text: Goddess Gabija says you need to strengthen your powers at the Entrance of Kateen Forest. Pass through Tenet Garden and go to the Entrance of Kateen Forest.
end.objective: Move to Entrance of Kateen Forest

start.text: Vaidutis is looking for help from somebody in the Tenet Church 1F.

progress.text: Vaidutis asked you to defeat Pawndel and Pawnd that are roaming around at the Tenet Church 1F.
progress.objective: Defeat Pawndel and Pawnd

end.text: You have defeated enough of Pawndel and Pawnd as Vaidutis requested. Return to Vaidutis.

start.text: Follower Donatas is waiting for the Revelator at the 1st floor of the church to hand over the scroll that turns oneself into a demon.

progress.text: Follower Donatas told you to gain some confidence by defeating Pawndel and Pawnd, so that you can transform into a demon using the demon transform scroll. After transforming yourself into a demon, talk to Pawndel and Pawnd, lure them to Apsauga Altar and defeat them.
progress.objective: Lure Pawndel and Pawnd to the Apsauga Altar

end.text: You defeated Pawndel and Pawnd after luring them to the altar. Talk to Follower Donatas.

8516.name: Lunatic Wizard (4)
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: You are now ready to transform those demons. Talk to Follower Donatas about the plan for the transformation.

progress.text: Follower Donatas told you that you are able to convert the demons using the power of the Globejas Altar. Activate the power of the altar, and if you attack those demons in an area where the influence of the altar's power reaches, you can convert those demons.
progress.objective: Convert demons at the Globejas Altar

end.text: You have converted the demons. Return to Donatas.

start.text: Follower Donatas is seeking for help from somone on the first floor of the Tenet Church.

progress.text: Follower Donatas told you to check the central barrier that had stopped working.
progress.objective: Check the Central Altar

end.text: You defeated the Mallet Wyvern at the central altar. Talk to Follower Donatas.

start.text: Follower Tomas wants help on the Tenet Church 1F.

progress.text: Follower Tomas told you to defeat the Yognomes around here, since they are trying to eat the altar and he can't concentrate his work.
progress.objective: Defeat Yognome

end.text: As Follower Tomas requested of you, you defeated all the Yognomes. Return to Follower Tomas.

start.text: Follower Tomas wants help on the 1st floor of the Tenet Church.

progress.text: Follower Tomas told you that it is necessary to defeat the Unknocker that is guarding the altar in order to disable the barrier. Attack the Unknocker when Follower Tomas lures it.
progress.objective: Defeat Unknocker

end.text: You defeated the Unknocker that was guarding the altar. Talk to Follower Tomas again.

start.text: Tiberius is waiting for someone's help in the Tenet Church 1F.

progress.text: Tiberius told you to obtain Vicious Essences by defeating demons, and then purify them into Purified Essences at the Altar of Purification, so he can complete his Holy Bomb.
progress.objective: Obtained the Purified Essences.

end.text: You have collected enough Purified Essences as Tiberius requested of you. Return to Tiberius.

start.text: Tiberius is waiting for someone's help in the Tenet Church 1F.

progress.text: Tiberius wants to test the Holy Bombs on Glizardon. Drink the Namott Holy Water to hide yourself, and then put the Holy Bomb onto a Glizardon's back.
progress.objective: Defeat Glizardon using the Holy Bomb

end.text: Glizardon died right away after the Holy Bomb on it's back exploded. Return to Tiberius and tell him about it.

start.text: Vaidas is waiting for help at the Tenet Church B1.

progress.text: Vaidas told you to charge the empty Holy Stone with the lives of the demons. He told you that when you place the stone and lure demons near it, the stone will automatically absorb the lives of the demons.
progress.objective: Charge the Holy Stone

end.text: You successfully charged the Holy Stone as Vaidas requested of you. Return to Vaidas.

start.text: Vaidas is waiting for help at the Tenet Church B1.

progress.text: Vaidas asked you to defeat the Glizardons that roam around the Tenet Church B1.
progress.objective: Defeat Glizardon

end.text: You defeated the Glizardons as Vaidas requested. Return to Vaidas.

start.text: Follower Tomas asked you to find Vaidutis at the Tenet Church B1.

progress.text: Vaidas told you that the demons have made a magic barrier at the basement's central altar. Destroy the barrier and continue looking for Follower Vaidutis.
progress.objective: Deactivate the barrier that Gesti created

end.text: Removed the barrier that was blocking the way to the 1st floor and defeated the Cyclops. Look for Vaidutis, who ran away to the 1st floor.

start.text: Follower Algis was waiting for you on the 2nd Floor. Talk to him and ask what to do.

progress.text: Saw Gesti scolding her subordinates
progress.objective: Go to the Bell Tower

end.text: Almost got caught by Gesti, but you found out something good. Gesti hasn't found the revelation yet. Ask Follower Algis about what to do next.

start.text: Gesti disappeared to the Central Hall. Talk to Follower Algis.

progress.text: Follower Algis says that in order to enter the hidden sanctuary, you need the Seal of Space, which is hidden in the Central Altar, but Gesti is roaming around the area and it is too dangerous. Occupy the Bell Tower, a good observation point.
progress.objective: Recapture the Bell Tower

end.text: Captured the Bell Tower. Talk to Follower Algis.

start.text: Captured the Bell Tower. Ask Follower Algis what to do next.

end.text: Gesti destroyed the Sventove Central Altar!

start.text: Gesti destroyed the Sventove Central Altar and has stolen the Seal of Space. You can't get the revelation at this rate and you'll be killed if you run into Gesti. Work with Follower Algis on finding a way to solve the situation.

progress.text: Follower Algis suggested using the pieces of the Altar that Gesti destroyed to immobilize her. Collect the altar pieces and place them on the eight pillars of Sventove Central Hall.
progress.objective: Make a trap at Sventove Central Hall

end.text: Inserted the altar pieces on the eight pillars. Return to Follower Algis.

start.text: Follower Algis is waiting for the Revelator in the Tenet Church 2F.

progress.text: Follower Algis says it'll be hard for him to secure the area alone so he asked you to activate the Malda Altar's powers to lure demons to their demise.
progress.objective: Activate the Malda Altar

end.text: Got rid of the demons and activated the altar. Return to Follower Algis.

start.text: Follower Algis is waiting for the Revelator in the Tenet Church 2F.

progress.text: Follower Algis says you need to defeat any pursuing demons. Use the Auka Altar to defeat demons and keep them from chasing you.
progress.objective: Charge the low level spirit crystal

end.text: Activated the altar and shifted the demons' interest to the altar. Return to Follower Algis.

start.text: Follower Algis is waiting for the Revelator in the Tenet Church 2F.

progress.text: Follower Algis asked you to defeat the Egnome wandering inside the church.
progress.objective: Defeat Egnome.

end.text: Defeated enough Egnome. Return to Follower Algis.

start.text: Inserted the altar pieces on the eight pillars of Sventove Central Hall. Gesti hasn't realized yet. Proceed to the next plan with Follower Algis.

progress.text: Gesti was weakened with the power of the Central Altar and the eight pillars. Now you can fight equally against Gesti. Disable Gesti while Follower Algis prepares the Divine Sphere.
progress.objective: Fight with Gesti

end.text: Failed to defeat Gesti as she escaped seriously injured. Talk to Follower Algis.

start.text: Gesti escaped, but there are still more things left to do in the church. Talk to Follower Algis again.

end.text: Use the Seal of Space on the pillar to enter the sanctuary and find the revelation.
end.objective: Find the revelation in the hidden sanctuary

start.text: Watcher Allen is waiting for someone's help at Nefritas Cliff.

progress.text: Watcher Allen asked you to collect the pieces of barrier the demons destroyed at Mazas Rest Place and take them to Follower Kayetonas.
progress.objective: Collect Destroyed Barrier Piece

end.text: Collected the pieces of the barrier. Give the pieces to Follower Kayetonas.

start.text: Watcher Allen is waiting for someone's help at Nefritas Cliff.

progress.text: Help Watcher Allen defeat the demons around the Tree Guard Post Barrier and charge the barrier with demon souls.
progress.objective: Charge the Tree Guard Post Barrier

end.text: The Tree Guard Post Barrier has been charged. Inform Follower Kayetonas about it.

start.text: Watcher Kenneth is waiting for someone's help at Nefritas Cliff.

progress.text: Watcher Kenneth is worried about the Demon Summoning Circles in Mairunas Knoll. Defeat the demons nearby Mairunas Knoll and remove the summoning circles.
progress.objective: Remove the Demon Summoning Circles

end.text: Removed the Demon Summoning Circles as requested by Watcher Kenneth. Tell Follower Kayetonas at Flower Greeting Hill that there were Demon Summoning Circles.

start.text: Watcher Kenneth is waiting for someone's help at Nefritas Cliff.

progress.text: Watcher Kenneth told you to weaken the demons to less than half HP, then use the holy powers of the barrier to sever their souls and defeat them.
progress.objective: Defeat severed demons' souls

end.text: Defeated enough severed souls in Pumpura Hill. Report to Follower Kayetonas.

start.text: Watcher Kenneth is waiting for someone's help at Nefritas Cliff.

progress.text: Kenneth asked you to defeat the nearby monsters while he takes a rest.
progress.objective: Defeat the demon monsters nearby Kenneth

end.text: Defeated the monsters while Kenneth rested. Tell Follower Kayetonas about it.

start.text: Follower Kayetonas at Nefritas Cliff is looking for someone who can fight with him.

progress.text: Minotaur appeared from the sky like Follower Kayetonas said. Defeat Minotaur so that it won't get to the Paladin Master.
progress.objective: Defeat Minotaur

end.text: Defeated Minotaur together with Follower Kayetonas. Talk to Follower Kayetonas.

start.text: The Paladin Master is waiting for you at Uzbaiga Hillside in Nefritas Cliff.

progress.text: The Paladin Master ask you to listen to Follower Algis about the Tenet Church, the first Paladin, and the Seal of Space. Listen to Follower Algis before he leaves.
progress.objective: Listen to Follower Algis' explanations

end.text: Listened to Follower Algis' explanations. Report to the Paladin Master and follow the next orders.

start.text: The Paladin Master is looking for you

progress.text: Gesti appeared. Help the Paladin Master!
progress.objective: Help the Paladin Master

end.text: The Paladin Master hit Gesti spot on, but stopped short of wounding her. Talk to the Paladin Master.

start.text: The Paladin Master is waiting for your help at Nefritas Cliff.

progress.text: The Paladin Master asked you to clear the area while he focuses on the Divine Sphere. Defeat the Throneweaver coming to attack you.
progress.objective: Defeat Throneweaver

end.text: The Paladin Master hit Gesti spot on, but stopped short of wounding her. Talk to the Paladin Master.

start.text: There is a foundation stone in the Royal Mausoleum. Read it.
start.objective: Read the Royal Mausoleum Foundation Stone

progress.text: The Foundation Stone said to wake the sleeping Guardians and stop the demons when they intrude. Wake the sleeping Boowook and stop the demons.
progress.objective: Wake the sleeping Boowook

end.text: The epitaph felt like it was foretelling something that you should do from now on. You better move as written on the epitaph.

start.text: Watcher Rikke of Tenet Garden is waiting for someone's help.

progress.text: Follower Rikke is worried about the Biteregina from Kateen Forest. Remove the beehive for him.
progress.objective: Remove the beehive

end.text: You barely defeated the angry Biteregina that appeared when you removed the beehive. Tell Rikke that there will no longer be threats to worry about.

start.text: Watcher Erra in Tenet Garden is waiting for someone's help.

progress.text: The Seedmias are causing trouble for Watcher Erra. Defeat the Seedmias and return to Erra.
progress.objective: Defeat Seedmia

end.text: Defeated the Seedmias as Erra requested. Inform Erra about it.

start.text: Watcher Erra in Tenet Garden is waiting for someone's help.

progress.text: Watcher Erra told you to wake up the sleeping Nepenthes in Piene Field by setting it on fire, and then to collect its sap while it's alive.
progress.objective: Extract Spiritually Enchanted Sap from Nepenthes

end.text: Collected all the Spiritually Enchanted Sap. Return to Watcher Erra.

start.text: Watcher Rikke of Tenet Garden is waiting for someone's help.

progress.text: Follower Rikke suggested to use a charm to brainwash Pantos, like how the guards did long ago.
progress.objective: Brainwash the Pantos

end.text: Successfully brainwashed the Pantos but they will still attack the caster. Complain about it to Rikke.

start.text: Watcher Rikke of Tenet Garden is waiting for someone's help.

progress.text: Follower Rikke gave you a stronger charm as a sign of apology. Burn the Panto Totem in Valyma Sanctum and try again. This time you must control the Pantos in order to defeat the Large Panto Spearman.
progress.objective: Control the Pantos and defeat the Large Panto Spearmen

end.text: As Follower Rikke said, after setting fire to the Panto Totem, the Pantos started taking orders. They helped defeat the Big Panto Spearman and the Old Talisman seems like it could be of use. Tell this to Rikke.

8607.name: In the Name of the Goddess!

start.text: Follower Alfonsas of Tenet Garden is waiting for someone's help.

progress.text: Follower Alfonsas said there are too many demons for him to handle by himself, so he asked for your help. Defeat the demons along the way to the Temple Courtyard.
progress.objective: Defeat demons

end.text: Defeated enough demons as Follower Alfonsas asked. Return to him.

start.text: Follower Alfonsas of Tenet Garden is waiting for someone's help.

progress.text: Follower Alfonsas said that scribbling on the Demon Summoning Circles alters them greatly. Avoid the monsters and scribble the circles.
progress.objective: Write over the Demon Summoning Circles

end.text: A little vandalism on the summoning circle absorbed back the summoned demons. It was small but a good try. Return and let Follower Alfonsas know about it.

start.text: Follower Algis is waiting for you at Tenet Garden.

progress.text: You've arrived at the Temple Courtyard and saw Gesti entering the church. Defeat the Chapparition and follow Gesti.
progress.objective: Pursue Gesti

end.text: Defeated Chapparition but Gesti already blocked the entrance. Ask Follower Algis what to do next.

start.text: Meet the Swordsman Master in Klaipeda

progress.text: The Swordsman Master taught that courage to protect allies is very important. Provoke the monsters using the provoking orb at Penitence Route of Cathedral and defeat them.
progress.objective: Use the provoking orb at Penitence Route of Cathedral

end.text: You have fulfilled the amount which the Swordsman Master requested. Report back to the Swordsman Master.

8701.name: Sword for the People and Shield [Highlander Advancement](1)

start.text: Find the Highlander Master in Klaipeda.

end.text: The Highlander Master told you that if you could help the Peltasta Master, he will offer you some lesson. Talk to the Peltasta Master.

8702.name: Sword for the People and Shield [Highlander Advancement](2)

required_quests.name: Sword for the People and Shield [Highlander Advancement](1)

start.text: The Peltasta Master is in a hurry. Talk to the Peltasta Master again.

end.text: The Peltasta Master told you that Uska received a request, but since he doesn't have time, he can't support it. Meet Uska on behalf of the Peltasta Master.

8703.name: Sword for the People and Shield [Highlander Advancement](3)

required_quests.name: Sword for the People and Shield [Highlander Advancement](2)

start.text: You told him that you will help Uska on behalf of the Highlander and Peltasta Masters. Talk to Uska again.

progress.text: Uska told you that the work needs to start again at Crystal Mine, but he can't due to the gigantic monster in Crystal Mine 2F. Get rid of the source of the rumor in Crystal Mine 2F.
progress.objective: Defeat the source of the rumor in Crystal Mine 2F

end.text: The source of the rumor was Bearkaras. Report to Uska when you defeat Bearkaras.

8704.name: Sword for the People and Shield [Highlander Advancement](4)

required_quests.name: Sword for the People and Shield [Highlander Advancement](3)

start.text: It is now time to go back to the Highlander Master again since you completed the request. Talk to Uska again.

end.text: You've completed the request of Uska. Return to the Highlander Master.

8705.name: Disturbance of the Winged Beast [Peltasta Advancement] (1)

start.text: Meet the Peltasta Master in Klaipeda

end.text: The Peltasta Master says the Highlanders are not keeping their promise of supplying shields. He says he will allow you to learn if you take care of this issue. First, go to the Highlander Master.

8706.name: Disturbance of the Winged Beast [Peltasta Advancement] (2)

required_quests.name: Disturbance of the Winged Beast [Peltasta Advancement] (1)

start.text: The Highlander Master seems very sorry, but you can't give up. Talk to the Highlander Master again.

end.text: Something wrong happened to the Fletcher Master whom the Highlander Master requested to. Find the Fletcher Master at Escanciu Village.

8707.name: Disturbance of the Winged Beast [Peltasta Advancement] (3)

required_quests.name: Disturbance of the Winged Beast [Peltasta Advancement] (2)

start.text: The Fletcher Master told you to go back, but you can't. Speak to him again.

progress.text: The Fletcher Master told you that if you could defeat Moas who broke the ingredients, he will change the turns. Defeat Moa at Fedimian Suburbs that are attacking the merchants.
progress.objective: Defeat Moas at Fedimian Suburbs

end.text: You succeeded on defeating Moas that were attacking the merchants. Report back to the Fletcher Master.

8708.name: Disturbance of the Winged Beast [Peltasta Advancement] (4)

required_quests.name: Disturbance of the Winged Beast [Peltasta Advancement] (3)

start.text: Since you've defeated Moas, you think you can get a firm promise for receiving the supplies. Talk to the Fletcher Master again.

end.text: You've received a firm promise from the Fletcher Master about receiving the supplies. Return to the Peltasta Master and report.

8709.name: Pirate on Land [Corsair Advancement]
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

8710.name: Wall of Sword and Shield [Rodelero Advancement]

start.text: Meet with the Rodelero Submaster at Gateway of the Great King.

progress.text: Rodelero Submaster is telling you that will show you how to fight with a sword and shield. Beat the Rodelero Submaster in sparring.
progress.objective: Spar with the Rodelero Submaster

end.text: You won sparring with the Rodelero Submaster. Talk again to the Rodelero Submaster.

start.text: Talk to the Archer Master in Klaipeda.

end.text: The Archer Master told you that if you could do him a favor, he will give you a lesson. As the Archer Master requested, go find the Fletcher Master at Escanciu Village and check what has happened to him.
end.objective: Find the Fletcher Master at Escanciu Village

start.text: The Fletcher Master is safe but the materials are late because of supplies. Talk to the Fletcher Master about the materials.

progress.text: The Fletcher Master is asking you to gather good quality Charcoal Stones. Get them from the Penitence Route. {nl}
progress.objective: Gather Charcoal Stones from Penitence Route

end.text: Thanks to the Golems, you've gathered a bunch of good quality Charcoal Stones. Give them to the Fletcher Master.
end.objective: Give them to the Fletcher Master

start.text: The materials that the Fletcher Master asked for is ready. Talk to the Archer Master.

end.text: The Fletcher Master is asking you to take the copy and go back to the Archer Master. Return to the Archer Master and show him the copy.
end.objective: Hand them over to the Archer Master

start.text: Find the Sapper Master in East Siauliai Woods

progress.text: The Sapper Master told you to defeat Biteregina threatening the people at the Owl Burial Ground.
progress.objective: Defeat Biteregina at the Owl Burial Ground.
