Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: Elder Aloizard took the red fragment and went to the Absenta Reservoir. The elder's granddaughter is looking to speak to you about the journal. Go and talk to her.

end.text: The burnt journal seems to contain important information. Go and find Elder Aloizard right away.
end.objective: Talk to Elder Aloizard at the Absenta Reservoir

90006.name: Offerings to the Goddess (1)
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: It's time to make the offering. Talk to Samsonas again.

progress.text: Samsonas is going to use this obelisk and has asked you to use one in another location. Go to the left side of the Vishikas Great Hall and make an offering to the obelisk there.
progress.objective: Make an offering to the Obelisk

end.text: Oddly enough, the offering caused nearby monsters to attack. Go to Samsonas right away and warn him about it before he makes his offering.

start.text: Nikodemas is looking around apprehensively. Talk to Nikodemas.

progress.text: Nikodemas says someone from the village wandered off and hasn't been back since. It seems they were headed towards the Drava Chapel Lot; go and look for them there.
progress.objective: Find the Village Resident at the Drava Chapel Lot

end.text: You successfully defeated the monster that attacked from underwater. Ask Napalis if they are all right.

start.text: Scalvis is worried about the monsters roaming around. Talk to Scalvis.

progress.text: Scalvis is worried about the large number of monsters around. Defeat nearby monsters to make the area safer for the village residents.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters nearby

end.text: The area seems safer now. Report back to Scalvis.

start.text: The Royal Mausoleum has had multiple devices to be protected from the demons. Humans can just pass by but guardians can be summoned if necessary. If there are reasons to summon, then activate the summoning device.

progress.text: Bearkaras appeared when you activated the device. Defeat it.
progress.objective: Defeat the Royal Mausoleum Guardian at Sesija Entrance

start.text: Talk to Elder Aloizard about the contents of the journal.

progress.text: Elder Aloizard says Modis once saw people with black hoods doing something at the Nesuga Small Corridor. Go to the Nesuga Small Corridor and see if you can find any clues.
progress.objective: Investigate the Nesuga Small Corridor

end.text: You have found a burnt painting. Elder Aloizard could possibly know something about the images in the painting.

start.text: Elder Aloizard seems to have recognized the images in the painting. Ask Elder Aloizard about the painting,

progress.text: A resident of the village came running, saying the Hydra has appeared. Go and check the Jeneuam Corridor, where the Hydra is said to be.
progress.objective: Go to the Jeneuam Corridor and find the Hydra

end.text: A colossal Hydra with a red gem on its body appeared but quickly fled. Return to Elder Aloizard.

start.text: The monster depicted in the painting is the Hydra. Ask Elder Aloizard about what to do next.

end.text: Elder Aloizard believes that, with your help, they might have a chance to destroy the red gem on the Hydra's body. Go see Hunter Modis and find a way to lure the Hydra.

90013.name: Clear the Corruption (4)
task: Defeat Sawpents and collect Bait Meat (0 / 8)
Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: You have collected enough bait. Now, collect blue herbs to disguise the scent of humans.

end.text: You have collected meat to use as bait and herbs to disguise your human scent. Bring the items to Hunter Modis.

start.text: Hunter Modis seems to have finished all preparations to lure the Hydra. Talk to Hunter Modis.

progress.text: Hunter Modis has set up a trap at the Heralve Vacant Lot. Place the bait on the trap to lure the Tyronas Hydra and defeat it.
progress.objective: Lure Tyronas Hydra

end.text: After defeating the Hydra, the red gem on its body shattered to pieces. Go and tell Elder Aloizard about the Tyronas Hydra.

start.text: Hunter Modis seems to have a problem at hand. Talk to Hunter Modis.

progress.text: Someone from the village accidentally drank the contaminated red water. Go to the right side of Svaigulys Hill in Letas Stream and collect Markazi Flowers to ease their pain.
progress.objective: Collect Markazi Flowers

end.text: You have collected enough Markazi Flowers now. Bring them to Hunter Modis.

90017.name: Recurrence Prevention (1)
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: The oil is ready now. Talk to Lanaldas before burning down the laboratory.

progress.text: Lanaldas wants you to burn down the laboratory to prevent future experiments. One is located in the Nesuga Small Corridor of the Absenta Reservoir, the other in the Wandering Sanctuary of the Pelke Shrine Ruins.
progress.objective: Set fire to the laboratory

end.text: You have burned down all the laboratories. Go and tell Lanaldas.

start.text: If you're really set on helping Elder Aloizard, he will be waiting for you at the Collapsed Hall Lot. Go and find him there.

end.text: If you're really set on helping Elder Aloizard, he will be waiting for you at the Collapsed Hall Lot. Go and find him there.

start.text: After you defeated the guardian of the Royal Mausoleum at Sesija Entrance as Rexipher ordered, Rexipher disappeared through the parvise. To find Cyrenia Odell, you should go through the parvise after Rexipher. He must be not far away.

progress.text: Rexipher says he will spare Cyrenia Odell's life but.. Rexipher's summon suddenly attacked!
progress.objective: Defeat the Cactusvel summoned by Rexipher

end.text: Barely defeated Cactusvel. Check if Cyrenia Odell is safe.

start.text: When arrived at Cranto Coast, you see the refugees who lost their wills to live. Ask Mayor Frege about the situation.

end.text: Mayor Frege wants ot talk about his problems to anyone. Listen to Mayor Frege.

start.text: Merchant Simonas is having some troubles gathering corals. Talk to Merchant Simonas.

progress.text: Merchant Simonas explains that due to the influx of monsters, the townspeople are unable to gather corals. Defeat the monsters in the coral mine.
progress.objective: Sweep the monsters of the Lhu'uvik Coral Reef

end.text: You've defeated all monster of the Lhu'uvik Coral Reef. Return to Merchant Simonas.

start.text: Despite your initial success, the monsters are reappearing in the coral mine. Talk to Merchant Simonas again.

progress.text: Merchant Simonas has some idea to put to test and asks you to ask the refugees about any suspicious things they might have witnessed.
progress.objective: Gather intel from the refugees

end.text: Gathered some various intel. Share them with Merchant Simonas.

90023.name: Smelly Pursuit
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: Merchant Simonas seems to have found something inside the pouches. Talk to Merchant Simonas.

progress.text: Merchant Simonas believes that the reason behind the monster infestation is this foul-smelling pouches. Find all the suspicious Pouches from the Lhu'uvik Coral Reef.
progress.objective: Find the Suspicious Pouches from the Lhu'uvik Coral Reef

end.text: It seems all the foul smelling pouches have been retrieved. Deliver them to Merchant Simonas.

start.text: Merchant Simonas seems to have an idea. Continue talking with Merchant Simonas.

progress.text: Merchant Simonas says that the perpetrator will come back to the crime scene to repeat the action. Hide in the Lhu'uvik Coral Reef until the perpetrator shows up.
progress.objective: Stake out in the Lhu'uvik Coral Reef until the perpetrator shows up

end.text: The monster has been defeated but the Lord Lieutenant and his ilk have ran away. Talk to Merchant Simonas and find what to do next.

start.text: Mayor Frege is in need of your help. Talk to Mayor Frege.

progress.text: Mayor Frege says that by using the suspicious pouch, you can lure monsters further away. Bury the suspicious pouch in the ground near the Atskiles Cay.
progress.objective: Lure the monsters to the suspicious pouch

end.text: You've defeated all the monsters lured in. Report to Mayor Frege.

start.text: You've obtained unique corals from monsters. Perhaps Merchant Felicia knows something about this?
start.objective: Ask Merchant Felicia about the corals

progress.text: Merchant Felicia says this unique coral is called Arnim Coral. It is extremely rare and it will help the townspeople greatly if you let her know where to find them.
progress.objective: Inspect the habitat of Arnim Coral

end.text: You've found the habitat of Arnim Coral. Tell Merchant Felicia the location.

90029.name: Emergency Treatment
task: Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: Tell Cyrenia Odell about what happened.

end.text: Cyrenia Odell says Rexipher's objective is the thing hidden in the Royal Mausoleum by the Great King Zachariel for the goddess. Follow Rexipher into the Royal Mausoleum.
end.objective: Pursue Rexipher at the Royal Mausoleum Entrance

90030.name: The Remains of the Wrecked Ship
task: Use the Magic Searching Stone to find a tool to open the box (0 / 1)
Write CommentPlease login to write own comments.

start.text: Technician Orion needs help. Talk to him.

progress.text: Technician Orion wants to lure the monsters by using bait. What is this bait made of? Place the bait along the road to Geltonas Highland and hide behind a tree to watch.
progress.objective: Prepare the trap and hide behind a tree

end.text: Placed the bait. Hide behind the tree and watch which monster shows up.

start.text: Placed the bait. Hide behind the tree and watch which monster shows up.

progress.text: It is the monster that the memo mentioned. Defeat Ravinepede and collect the treasure!
progress.objective: Defeat the lured Ravinepede

end.text: Defeated Ravinepede. Return to Technician Orion.
Collected all amulets of Hogma. Place the amulet in the stone pillar on the south of Geltonas Highland.
end.objective: Place the amulet of Hogma on the stone pillar in Geltonas Highland

start.text: Collected all amulets. Place the amulet in the stone pillar on the south of Geltonas Highland.
start.objective: Place the amulet on the stone pillar

progress.text: Monsters suddenly attacked. Defeat them all.
progress.objective: 몰려드는 몬스터 처치

end.text: Got a very old map from the stone pillars. Give it to Friedka.

start.text: After reading the notice to recruit more soldiers, you feel like you should help. Talk to Knight Titas at the west forest of Siaulai.

progress.text: Knight Titas told you that it will be better to help Julian's squad that is trying to penetrate the way to the Gateway of the Great King from Dvasia Peak. Defeat 100 monsters at Dvasia Peak.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters at Dvasia Peak

end.text: You've defeated many monsters at Dvasia Peak. Report to Commander Julian.

start.text: James is looking at your bag. Talk to him.

progress.text: James suggested a bet. Defeat the monsters in Owl Burial Ground.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters roaming around the Owl Burial Ground.

end.text: You've completed the amount you bet with James. Talk to him.

start.text: Grave Keeper Romas is looking at you with pity. Talk to him.

progress.text: Grave Keeper Romas says he had to bury a Revelator once so do not be over confident. Defeat 15 monsters nearby within 2 minutes and prove that you are not weak.
progress.objective: Pass Grave Keeper Romas' Test

end.text: Defeated 15 monsters in 2 minutes. Talk to Grave Keeper Romas.

start.text: The Paladin Master has something to say. Talk to him.

progress.text: The Paladin Master says there is a monster slaying people. Find and defeat the spooky Chapparition in the Tenet Church.
progress.objective: Defeat Field Boss Chapparition

end.text: Defeated the Chapparition. Report to the Paladin Master.

start.text: There is a person you see for the first time, but if blurry. Talk to him.

end.text: The resentful feels sorry to the sister who fought with him and left the house. Find the sister and give her the necklace.
end.objective: Find the sister of resentful soul and give the necklace.

start.text: There is an antsy soldier. Talk to him.

progress.text: Resentful soldier says he remembered his mission but he just can't go. Take his mission and defeat the monsters for him.
progress.objective: Defeat the monster in Sunset Flag Forest

end.text: Completed the resentful soldier's mission. Return and report to thim.

start.text: A messenger suddenly appeared. Talk to him.

progress.text: You can't just call on the messenger anytime. As a sign of apology, deliver the letter to Officer Ripper in Fedimian.
progress.objective: Deliver the letter to Ripper in Fedimian

end.text: Delivered the letter to Officer Ripper in Fedimian and received money. Give money to the messenger.

start.text: Officer Liudas is looking carefully at your chick accessory. Talk to him.

progress.text: Officer Liudas say he'll give you an accessory if you defeat the monsters around. Defeat the monsters around Lemprasa Pond.
progress.objective: Defeat the monsters in Lemprasa Pond

end.text: Defeated a lot of monsters in Lemprasa Pond. Report to Offier Liudas.

start.text: Colin looks lonely. Talk to Colin.

progress.text: Historian Collin wants to honor the explorers who died while exploring this area. Burn the oration in their honor in front of the epitaph at Rukas Plateau.
progress.objective: Burn the oration

end.text: Burned the oration in fron of the epitaph in Rukas Plateau. Report to Historian Collin.

start.text: Gathered all materials needed for the repair. Return to the Highlander Master's practice area and repair the seal.
start.objective: Repair the wooden seal for practice

end.text: Fixed the seal. Report to the Highlander Master.
